tools.name: inite_services
tools.description: INITE's services as a ladder, cheapest first: each step's id, name, price in the reader's currency and one line. `slug` gives one step in full, `full: true` all of them: what it delivers, how long it takes, the kind of price, the refund, and how it starts (a call with inite_book_call or a page to op

tools.name: inite_slots
tools.description: The call times INITE's calendar has free, as ISO instants, with the call length and the host's time zone. Pass one of them to inite_book_call as starts_at.

tools.name: inite_book_call
tools.description: Book a call with the INITE team for a named person, with their consent and their own email. starts_at must be a slot from inite_slots; topic is a service id from inite_services (default: diagnostic). They get a calendar invite; the answer's booking_key moves (inite_move_call) or cancels (inite_cance

tools.name: inite_move_call
tools.description: Move a booked call to another time from inite_slots, with the person's consent. They get an updated invite.

tools.name: inite_cancel_call
tools.description: Cancel a booked call, only when the person asked. Free; they get an email.

tools.name: inite_contact
tools.description: Send a message to the INITE team for a named person; the reply goes to their email. For a question that needs a conversation, inite_book_call is faster.

tools.name: inite_guides
tools.description: INITE's guides (PDF, a few pages each): titles, what each covers, its page. Pass slug and email to send one to a person by email, only with their consent.

tools.name: inite_connect
tools.description: How to add another INITE MCP server to this client, when the person wants something this one does not do. With no argument, the server beside this one; `for`, the one that does a job; `all: true`, every server. Returns the URL, the Claude Code command and the custom-connector step.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "portal" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: inite_book_call, inite_cancel_call · Private data: inite_contact · Public sink: inite_book_call, inite_cancel_call, inite_contact, inite_guides.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: inite_book_call, inite_cancel_call · Private data: inite_contact · Public sink: inite_book_call, inite_cancel_call, inite_contact, inite_guides

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
